dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: Hehe, healthy miracle tonic of course! Now, my friend, you're clearly someone with a radiant glow, but what if I told you I could make you shine even brighter?

dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: This isn't just any old fruit juice, it's the confluence of ancient medicinal wisdom with modern creative techniques. It's the real deal, that I can guarantee — a hundred and ten percent!

dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: Only the finest ingredients and most skilled labor went into composing this concoction. In fact, I guarantee that after drinking my healthy tonic, you'll run faster than a weasel thief, jump higher than a forest boar, and train harder than you've ever trained before!

dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: So what do you say? Would you like to try a bottle?
